pipeline.target: IL-7Ralpha (blocks both IL-7 and TSLP signaling)
pipeline.license_origin: In-licensed from Bristol-Myers Squibb (Sep 2019); rights re-acquired from Horizon/Amgen Nov 2023

indications.trial_design: Open-label Phase 2a, 33 severe/very severe AA patients, 200 mg loading weekly x4 then every-other-week through week 36, follow-up to week 52; intended to enable advancement into pivotal trials.
Phase 2 randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled study evaluating safety and efficacy of ADX-914 in moderate-to-severe AD.

excluded_legacy_terminated.reason: Asset sold/divested to Akebia Therapeutics on Nov 28, 2025; Colorado License Agreement transferred. No longer a Q32 asset. NCT06419205 was WITHDRAWN.
